summary: Town roofs come in weathered clay, concrete tile and slate, brick is old red-brown and stone is coursed rubble in lime mortar.
rationale: A material and colour change: matched stills from the battle camera, the street and the studio show the roof palette, brick and stone side by side with the parent revision.
before_ref: git archive of b054bb01 into a scratch copy, rendered with the same fixtures and flags.

capture.renderer: Godot 4.7.2 Forward+, High preset, 1600x900, day; Compatibility renderer checked on the studio stage
capture.comparison: Uncropped captures reduced to 800x450 panels, before left and after right: town overview, driveway, house plans.

validation: building-components, structure-batches and determinism tests pass
limitations: Moss-patch shapes and the unchanged parts of each image vary only where the change reaches; no performance change (colours and one shader branch).
